lines.text: Scan any QR code. Pay with USDC.
The merchant gets paid in local currency, in seconds.
This is Zygo. Earn globally. Pay locally.
So why does this matter? Today, cashing out crypto is a gamble.
You sell to a stranger on a P2P desk, and risk a frozen bank account. You lose up to thirty percent to tax, pay hidden forex spreads, and still wait on slow settlement.
Zygo flips that. Don't cash out. Just pay.
Scan any local QR, see the full USDC cost upfront, lock it in escrow, and a verified provider pays the merchant directly.
Here's a live payment, from scan to settlement. The customer is on the left. A liquidity provider is on the right.
The customer scans the cafe's existing UPI QR code, and enters ten rupees.
Zygo quotes the full cost upfront. Zero point zero nine six USDC. No hidden spread.
One approval in the wallet, and the USDC is held in Solana escrow, until the payout is verified.
The order is routed to a verified liquidity provider, who accepts it.
The provider pays the merchant ten rupees through UPI, and marks it paid, with the receipt as proof.
The customer sees the proof, and confirms the merchant was paid, with a signed message.
Escrow releases. The provider receives the USDC in their wallet, and the payment is settled on-chain.
Crypto becomes spendable in daily life.
Earners keep dollars, and spend local. Merchants get paid in local currency, with zero setup. Providers earn on a verified flow. And Solana gets real-world USDC payments.

And it's already live. A hundred and fifty beta users. A hundred and twenty thousand dollars processed in four weeks, across US to India and UAE to India corridors, with ten liquidity providers onboarded.
Next, we scale through our Payout API, and our QR Payments API.
Zygo. Earn globally. Pay locally. Try it today, at zygo dot cash.
